page.title: Security center
page.description: Your security score, what to fix first, and every session and device that can reach this control plane.
page.loadError: Could not load the security center.

score.label: Security score
score.summaryOnly: Only admins see the full checklist. Ask an admin to review the items behind this score.

admin_without_mfa.title: Admins without two-factor or a passkey
admin_without_mfa.pass: Every admin has two-factor or a passkey
admin_without_mfa.why: A leaked admin password alone would give full control of every app and secret.

account_flagged.title: Accounts flagged for a new password
account_flagged.pass: No account is flagged for a password reset
account_flagged.why: Someone reported a sign-in to these accounts that was not theirs.

recovery_codes_missing.title: Accounts with no recovery codes left
recovery_codes_missing.pass: Every two-factor account has recovery codes
recovery_codes_missing.why: Losing the authenticator app would lock these accounts out with no way back in.

no_admin_passkey.title: No admin has a passkey
no_admin_passkey.why: Passkeys cannot be phished or reused, unlike passwords and codes.

token_root.title: API tokens that hold root
token_root.why: A root token can do anything an admin can, including minting more tokens.

token_no_expiry.title: API tokens that never expire
token_no_expiry.pass: Every API token has an expiry
token_no_expiry.why: A token without an expiry keeps working long after anyone remembers it exists.

token_signin_approve.title: API tokens that can approve sign-ins
token_signin_approve.pass: No API token can approve sign-ins
token_signin_approve.why: Such a token can reveal sign-in codes and approve new browsers for its owner.

token_unused.title: API tokens unused for a long time
token_unused.why: Unused tokens are pure risk: revoke what nothing needs anymore.

sessions_old.title: Old sessions still signed in
sessions_old.why: Long-lived sessions on forgotten browsers are an easy way in.

new_device_approval_off.title: New browser approval is off
new_device_approval_off.why: Without it, a stolen password signs in from anywhere with no second look.

approval_password_only.title: Only password sign-ins need new browser approval
approval_password_only.pass: Every sign-in method needs new browser approval
approval_password_only.why: Passkey and OAuth sign-ins from a new browser skip the approval step today.

code_login_admins.title: Admins can sign in with a code
code_login_admins.pass: Admins cannot sign in with a code
code_login_admins.why: A code sent to an open session or email is a weaker path into an admin account.

public_exposure.title: Container ports open to the internet
public_exposure.why: Docker publishes ports past the host firewall, so these are reachable by anyone.

docker_api_exposed.title: The Docker API is reachable from the internet
docker_api_exposed.pass: The Docker API is not exposed
docker_api_exposed.why: Unauthenticated Docker API access is full control of the server.

offbox_backup_off.title: Off-box control plane backups are off
offbox_backup_off.why: Losing this machine would lose every app definition, secret and certificate.

master_key_rotation.title: The master key is missing or overdue for rotation
master_key_rotation.pass: The master key was rotated recently
master_key_rotation.why: Rotating the master key limits what an old leaked copy can decrypt.

secrets_old.title: Secrets older than {{detail}}
secrets_old.why: Old secrets are more likely to have leaked somewhere along the way.

tls_not_public.title: Domains without a publicly trusted certificate
tls_not_public.pass: Every domain has a public certificate
tls_not_public.why: Browsers warn on these domains, which trains people to click through warnings.

hsts_off.title: HSTS is off while real certificates are in place
hsts_off.pass: HSTS is on or not needed yet
hsts_off.why: Without HSTS, a first visit over plain HTTP can be intercepted and downgraded.

agents_outdated.title: Node agents older than the minimum version
agents_outdated.why: Old agents miss security fixes that the control plane already expects.

login_anomalies.title: Bursts of failed sign-ins
login_anomalies.why: Many wrong passwords in a short time usually means someone is guessing.

own_mfa.title: Your account has no two-factor or passkey
own_mfa.pass: Your account has two-factor or a passkey
own_mfa.why: Your password alone is all it takes to sign in as you.

own_recovery_codes.title: You have no recovery codes left
own_recovery_codes.why: Without them, losing your authenticator locks you out.

own_account_flagged.title: Your account needs a new password
own_account_flagged.why: A sign-in to your account was reported as not yours.

actions.disable_code_login_admins: Turn off code sign-in for admins

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Browsers signed in to this account. The location is the network the address belongs to, not a place.
sessions.revokeError: Could not sign out that session.
sessions.revokeOthersAdmin: Sign out every session of this account
sessions.revokeOthersDone: Signed out {{count}} session(s). Trusted browsers and waiting sign-ins were reset too.
sessions.devicesDescription: Browsers that skip new browser approval. Remove any you do not recognise.
sessions.tokensDescription: Tokens owned by this account, with when each was last used.
sessions.confirmBody: Every other browser signed in to this account is signed out, and trusted browsers and waiting sign-ins are reset.

policy.title: Security policy
policy.description: Platform rules for sign-in approval and API token hygiene. Changes apply right away.
policy.adminOnly: Only admins can change the security policy.
policy.approvalOff: New browser approval is turned off on this server, so this setting has no effect until it is turned back on.
policy.maxLifetime: Longest API token lifetime (days, 0 for no limit)
policy.warnUnused: Flag tokens unused for (days, 0 to stop)
policy.disableUnused: Disable tokens unused for (days, 0 to stop)
policy.disableHint: A token gets a notice first and is disabled {{days}} days later unless it is used.
policy.saveError: Could not save the security policy.

account.title: Require approval for new browsers on my account
account.description: Ask one of your signed-in sessions to approve any new browser, whatever sign-in method it uses.
account.on: Approval required for every sign-in method on your account.
account.off: Your account follows the platform policy.
account.flagged: A sign-in to your account was reported as not yours. Change your password now; that clears this warning.

alertPage.title: Was this sign-in not you?
alertPage.description: Confirm to sign out that browser, forget your trusted browsers and flag your account for a new password.
alertPage.confirm: It was not me, sign it out
alertPage.done: Done. That browser is signed out and your account is flagged. Sign in and change your password now.
alertPage.doneNoSession: Done. That session had already ended. Your account is flagged: sign in and change your password now.
alertPage.missing: This link is missing its token. Open the link from the email again.
alertPage.error: This link is invalid, already used or expired.
